text: I played this game for ~6 months as a F2P player and was powerful enough to be competitive in most events. The community of players is good and why I stuck around for so long the game itself is extremely predatory and intrusive for how it pushes ads and in game purchases. It also gets repetitive after KVK events start. Also the reason I'm updating this review is that the Ads are not actually representative and the Tower Defence elements are only relevant for the first ~2 hours of gameplay.

Not as advertised, unfortunately. played the game for a while, but it was very repetitive. The in game chats are a gateway for predators, so not suitable for children. Sent screen shots to support, and their response was they will monitor the offenders behaviour going forward. I tried deleting my account, but they want a 30 day cooling off period, so you can't even delete your account. I have since deleted the game. Do not recommend.

Great if you like the Build a Base strategy style games, which there are literally thousands of now, but I downloaded this game solely on the Tower Defence style aesthetic that was advertised, only to find that the game is barely anything like that, so I've uninstalled it. Sadly, I enjoyed playing the ad version, this version had me bored out my mind within five minutes. Hopefully one day there will be an ad that actually showcases the game rather than trick people into downloading them!!

I played for about a month but didn't see anything resemblance to the ads, it is definitely a "Catfish" among games. I was utterly disappointed and won't be wasting my time with it any further. A word for any others thinking about downloading this game. It is genuinely nothing like the ADS at any level, you would be better off considering another game.

Just like Whiteout Survival, the content in the ads is a very, very small part of the game. Whereas there might not be any third party ads, you are lightly pressured by ads to buy in-game items in order to level up or skip in-game timers. The kicker is, nothing happens, you don't "play" this game, you just tap on the part of the screen it tells you to. There is no strategy or any way to fail. Tap Slop.

The construction time is unfeasible, sometimes taking 5 days, the events aren't explained and you end up losing money, the game ends up pushing you to make in-game purchases because at a certain point, It gets boring to play. There are moments in the game where you have nothing to do, you lack resources, and that also hurts the game. What keeps me playing is the alliance system, because without alliances I would have uninstalled the game already.

It's not the game advertised and so not what I am looking for and a waste of time for me. It is actually a decent idle kingdom builder with some additional mini games that resemble tower defence. Also I expect a reply to this explaining there is a lot of content to explore as this appears to be the standard response, but that's the problem. There is too much stuff in it. I just want to shoot mobs and build a few towers like in the ad.

The game itself is okay, but it is not as advertised. If you downloaded this based on the adverts you've seen, you're going to be very disappointed. The ad content is a rip off of another game, Thronefall. As predicted the developer has replied to this saying that the ads only show a tiny portion of the game - which isn't true. I spent a few days playing it quite heavily and I can't find the content that's actually on display in the ads, leading me to believe it doesn't exist.

ok. let's set this straight. Firstly it's nothing like the ads you see. This is a territory clan game. Clans can fight each other. Gather resources, upgrade troops etc etc you can play this without spending a penny. but it'll take you a very long time to get anywhere. 100% a Pay 2 Win game. constantly new offer to buy stuff for £4.99 each pack. you can see that the top clans in each region are constant payers. The game is good. passes the time, but be prepared to pay something.

I only installed this to write this review. Your ads are annoying and falsely advertise the actual product according to the 1 star reviews. EDIT: No I will not play the game. It has been shoved in my face to the point where it has put me off of playing it. I deleted the game as soon as I finished writing my first review. Was watching a documentary on YouTube, only for your waste of time and space Kingshot ad to interrupt it. I hate your ads and I hate your game.

Downloaded the game, and it is NOTHING like the mis-leading adverts. visual and game playing are nothing like adverts. And yes I played it for a while the full game to see and hope it went like the ads, sadly no. the ads are more fun than the game. Love the statuary repsonse to my review, obviously didnt read it as I said I played more of the game! And seen the same response added to others who have experienced the same thing.

Another misleading ad game. Played this for about a week and you pretty much never see anything like the ads. It's a relatively boring base building game gated by time and in app purchases. Rarely there's an event that slightly resembles the ads but... not really. Don't waste your time. To the developer, please only reply to this if you can explain why the ads are so misleading. You must not deny that they are misleading, because they are. All it does is annoy players.

The game is nothing like the ad, the ad is great fun but the game is really generic, it's the same game as many others. You eventually run out of resources and either have to pay real world cash to progress or wait a long time for your resources to restock, i feel like every game I download lately is exactly the same with a different coat of paint on. I'd of preferred the ad game

difficult to delete account, game is repetitive Edit: thanks for response. Tried following the instructions to delete. You have to enter lots of fields then wait 15 days. This is a game. It shouldn't be that difficult. Oh and even if you enter all the info requested the in built form it might still give you an error message saying something like more data needed without saying what data.

Huh this is like a btec version of the better game called throne fall, although throne fall did well without the aggressive advertising of "no ads" cause it didn't need a basic qualify of life design choice to be a good game, king shot is like second hand slop in comparison, if you did take time to make a bit more detail here and there and some story, actual unique selling point other than "no ads" and had it's own original plot that doesn't carbon copy throne fall then it might be a good game.

The Adds for the game are more fun than the game itself. Thanks for responding in such a condescending manner... FYI I did play the game and it sucked. The simplicity of playing the game in the advert was appealing and why I downloaded it. I found the game itself uninteresting and your suggestion of playing it again will just waste more of my time. Have a wonderful day.

nothing like the ads. I thought it was gonna be the fun easy gameplay shown in the ads but instead it's a base building game like clash of clans with timed events to build and upgrade the base.. absolute scam EDIT: Yes, I played enough to get to the 'action' gameplay from the ads but its still only like 5% of the actual gameplay. Most of it is sitting idle on your town upgrading resources, I wonder why they didn't show this in the ads 🤔

Bog standard town building game with all the expected "join a group and go maybe fight other players". And waiting for upgrades. The gameplay for the advertisements is exclusive to minigames that you can win by not doing anything, since towers and collected heroes and NPCs can win by themselves. It's fun waiting 10+ days for an upgrade so a barely visible NPC does 3.5% more damage in a mini game you'll play maybe once or twice a day. 80% of the gameplay is waiting. Yawn.

Dont Bother, game is nothing like the 4 Billion ads, that you are bombarded with online these days for it, which show it as a Tower Defence type game. IT'S NOT! This Con of a game is predominantly driven towards pay to win in order to advance on majority of reward sections. FIND ANOTHER GAME! Update, game is beyond boring, contrary to Dev comments, you never get what is in the ads. The ads are a complete Rip Off of another game called THRONEFALL, so avoid Kingshot like a plague.

This game is way too complicated, too many different things to upgrade, too many different styles of gameplay, and too many buttons to press. The tutorial is painful, it lasts for days and holds your hand way too much. Although the fun gameplay mode in the advert is part of it, it's a very small part, and most of the game is just clicking "Upgrade" over and over in 100 different ways with no clear reward for those upgrades except numbers going up.

Played and to call it a tower defence game is like calling a waffle a sandwich. It's a base builder, of which have played a few. It's a reskin of many similar games, so very little new, a couple of tower gimmicks not enough to make a real difference. They are all the same game underneath. Okay, to play for a bit, but to really progress, you will need to spend some serious money down the line if you really want to achieve anything. Adverts are horribly misleading

Tried the game for two weeks, got to level 18. The ads we all get bombarded with are bait-and-switch. The game itself is a resource management sim with warlike elements. Any tower defense element is pretty watered down. It is visually pleasing and overall doesn't feel as stressful as other games of the sort, but ends up having the same issues as quickly slowing pace of evolution and need to be constantly online to deal with attacks (shields are limited). Seemingly well done but not for me.

I've accidentally downloaded this game 3 times, because the ads are fun to play. The actual game requires more strategy than I can do. I'm not patient enough to wait for the upgrades after a while. And I just don't understand the whole upgrading fighters part, and... it hurts my brain. BUT, I love playing these ads. PLEASE can you make a dumbed-down version; make an actual game of the version you use for the ads. "Kingshot 4 Dummies". That would suit me fine! 😁

The ads you see are fake, obviously. it's essentially a reskin of Whiteout Survival so far, but with pve enemies attacking you every so often. it's fun, but falsely advertises itself a bit, which is deliberate. monetisation will get more aggressive in the future as the playerbase grows, with numerous event passes to buy for more progression and Heroes to collect to stay at the top. If you're casual, you're fine. If you're competitive, you'll be spending a lot of money

I downloaded this game because the ads made it look fun, unique, and full of actual gameplay. Unfortunately, the real game is nothing like what was shown. once you open the app you just get a completely different experience. It felt misleading and honestly a waste of time. If the developers advertised the real gameplay, I might have given it a fair chance and most likely enjoyed the game. But when the entire download is based on false advertising, it’s hard to.

Do not play this game... You will regret your time after level 10. After level 10 (which you need more after this level), the game decreases simultaneous construction numbers to one. Normally it is two and you need to pay to increase two (back) again. I will not pay this. Not because it is a lot of money (which is not - £2.99) but God knows what they will reduce and want you/me to pay in the future...

The ads are complete lies. You get maybe a couple days of it as a minigame, and then it just stops mattering. Once you've built all the walls, you can quit, because there's nothing else to do in that minigame. Even the real game is annoying. It takes literal days of waiting to build troops, and then someone stupidly powerful can show up while I'm offline, attack a dozen times, and destroy weeks' worth of time. What's even the point? The PvP doesn't matter and isn't fun.

And the app now freezes when opened. It freezes at checking version. Adverts aren't true. They show some kind of tower defense, but the actual game is a p2w world. Crazy to advertise something completely different. It's an interesting game for a bit, until it gests a bit repetitive. And, yes devs, I have explored the game and seen all the game play, there's no tower defense aspect apart from a very tiny 2-min side quest.

This is a weird one. The game isn't tower defense at all. it's an economy/management game with PvP and PvE aspects. Though I'm enjoying this game I struggle to recommend it. the game pushes monetisation hard, a lot of events can't be completed without paying. The pacing of this game of horrific, it starts fast paced as you expect, but it slows down from days, to weeks for some progression which can of course be bypassed by spending money. The UI is also busy and cluttered, expect to get lost.

The game plays great, but the pay-to-win aspect is way too overpowering. Let's say you returned to the game after a couple of years missing out on the battle passes. Well, now your standard cards have to face against evo and hero cards, all of which have no drawbacks except maybe the mercy of not being in 1-2 cycles. If you think skill solely can get you far, you are mistaken.

I downloaded this game expecting what looked like a fun Tower Defense game, turns out it's incredibly dull with zero tower defense gameplay. Click a button at the bottom left to build a house, now build a mine by left clicking the same button, now build a barracks, now upgrade the house by using the same button, and now upgrade the barracks etc. It might have no ads but there are plenty of opportunities to buy upgrades to make things happen faster but it's not what was was advertised. Avoid.

the customer service is dreadful. i forgot to connect my account, and after the recent major update, all of my data has been wiped off, and i lost my account. i tried to recover through the customer service, and it looks like it is a bot . It took 3 days, and yet nothing happened. I'm very disappointed because i spend money on the games. not recommended!!

False advertising and too repetitive. It's not like the ads and once you do the rounds a couple of times, you find yourself just playing the game to continue chatting to people in your alliance. You hit a wall and need to pump money into the game to progress, as after a certain amount of time it takes forever to level up buildings, etc. Don't bother wasting your time and money on this. Also, it seems virtually impossible to delete your account when you want to leave.

Completely unlike the game play ads. There aren't any tower defence elements, even in the mini games. I have played the game for around a month now, and I haven't seen any content included in those ads - so when the developer comments under this review 'the ads only show a tiny portion of the game' that's plain LIES, it isn't ANYWHERE in the game. These false misleading ads are just scams to get you playing and they should be banned.

Terrible game. Like many of these types of game it is only fun if you are a whale and have unlimited money to throw at it. If you're a casual gamer, who doesn't mind giving some money to the developers and are looking for a friendly community and to make friends then this game isn't for you. Everything is over priced and those that can afford the endless loot boxes can ruin the game for people looking to enjoy a game and build something with like minded people.

Edit: The ads do not show ANY of the game! It is not a tower defence game. At all. It is very much false advertising. it's a fun game that I enjoyed my time with. I joined a fun, friendly guild and waged war across the map, there truly were no ads. However, the game is advertised as a sort of tower defence game, and I love those, it is not a tower defence game, it is a city builder. So it gets the lowest score for the false advertising.

Absolutely nothing like the adverts, not quite sure why its allowed to advertise something totally different. False advertising and the game itself is rather boring and constantly begging to spend money. I get these games cost money to design etc but its excessive! Would get more stars if it was anything like its adverts, even as a side quest mode!! Very much like the game whiteout, another lying game. Wait for the standard copy and paste response from the developer saying the ad only shows....

Installed this because of a trailer that showed loads of fighting. Liked the fact that you level up buildings etc. but there's little to no tutorial and I had no idea what I was doing. The game just kept saying "click here" so thinking the game should really be playing itself, I uninstalled it. Okies the fact it KEEPS adding me if I want personalised ads. No I don't and I'm fed up having to choose.

100% Reskinned Version of WhiteOut Survival... if you've played that game, this is exactly the same, despite looking quite different during the early stages. Complete grind-fest, masses of repetition and a progress arc that ticks over at a progressively slow (ok glacial) pace unless you are prepared to stump up real cash (why would you, there's no real reward in the gameplay of this paper-thin cash cow). Not recommended - it'll milk your time and/or wallet without giving a return on investment.

It's alright for a mobile game and you don't have to pay (at least as long as I was playing) It's basically Tribal Wars but less brutal. Community was decent which was the best thing tbh. Rating is for the lying ads. There is next to NO tower defense element to this game - what the ads show you just isn't present at all. the closest thing to Tower defense is a mini game you can literally go to sleep for.

Saw an ad, came here to download just so I could leave a bad review. Glad to see other reviews saying the ad is false. More than that, it's blatant plagiarism. There's an amazing game called "Thronefall" and the ad is an inferior copy of that. Go and find "Thronefall" if you liked the ad, so the money goes to the people who actually made an effort.

Unfortunately, although it was a brilliant game that I've spent many hours playing and also spent money buying packs and bits for and then they have a system glitch. It stops you from logging in for days due to this issue. They then fix this, however when I log in only to find out half of my achievements have reset. ZERO help from customer services, they ignored my last 7 messages. So now raising a visa dispute with the bank for items purchased. Items that have now vanished with ZERO help. SHAME

Nothing like the ads The ads show a medieval version of a game I've played before where you go down a path getting coins by killing enemies and using those coins to build towers to help you reach the next area and progress down the path. However this game is nothing like that, this is a base building game where you have to collect resources to build your base.

IF you have a problem support will tell you it's your device not the game. It can be fun to play for a while, but the higher you go, the disparity between paying players & rest of people becomes bigger and bigger. non stop events where top 10 players get stronger with each one. The paywall hero is so expensive to get that again, only the strongest player will get him, and you stand no chance against them. One whale can wipe out an entire strong alliance. But it doesn't have ads so that's that

The game is good and enjoyable. However I have to give it a 1 Star because it is NOT the game described in it'thes adverts. It bares no resemblance at all. If the Devs had confidence in their own product and advertised that, then I would be giving it a 4, but due to the fact that the company begins their relationship with their customers based on a lie I give it a 1. I wish I could give 0, but that's not the way the Store is set up.

Edited in response to the Devs comments: I have 40+ hours in this game, the advertisement that you see is NOT in the game. Which is a shame as the game is a decent game, minus the aggro events and lack of options to deal with whales. Pay-to-win game with a ridiculous amount of additional heavy gambling mini games. The game would be 3+ stars but it has events which encourage unfun gameplay and the game has little to do in the late game. Save your time, play something else.

Sold as an easy game for fun, but very quickly you need to join an alliance and DEMANDS you keep up with certain tasks to continue playing or you get kicked from alliances only to find yourself out alone again with little chance of progression. I don't want to play a game that DEMANDS of my time, it's supposed to fun, NOT consuming. played for about 4 months then realised it was taking over my life on repetitive tasks.

You saw the "we have no ads" and thought, finally, a game that might be decent, and if I enjoy it, I'm sure I'll buy a few things. get prepared for over $350 worth of transaction which are rolled daily,weekly and monthly. the pay to win is so bad that even the alliances (clans) boast they have heavy investors. Save yourself the trouble thinking you can progress any where near the middle by not spending atleast $50 a month

Kind of like the ads, there's a lot of different game modes which make it more interesting than your standard RTS game. I think it's a little bit misleading if you came here from the ads you see because while there are tower defense battles it is primarily PVP RTS. I think this game could be improved by having some completely PVE servers where people who were interested in the many PVE elements of the game could choose to just play together cooperatively.

System automatically deleted paid for progress and mods won't refund. They have an automated system that deletes progress if you break rules. I didn't break any rules and provided proof but they won't restore my progress or refund the large amount of money I spent. Don't spend money on this game because you can lose them for no reason and be refused a refund. Also the game isn't anything like the ads and just copies from other games. I'm surprised it's allowed on the play store, it's a scam

I was enjoying this game for a time and even spent a little bit of money on it. Then I saw the fake ads that advertise it as a tower defense game. This is NOT a tower defense game, it's just a little town builder where you gather resources and upgrade buildings, occasionally enemies will attack your base but you have little control over this. I was very disappointed when I saw the ads.

same type of game, doesnt do what it says on the tin. usual misleading game, playing the demo as a ad is fun, the real game gets into the boring build the city type. played several times and keep deleting it. wont download again, they should of gone with the first setup and ditch city building. make the game like the ads, not like the game itself.

The ad is misleading as someone else already said. I downloaded the game thinking it would be just a straight on game like the ads and despite getting bored of it because the actual add gameplay never came up, I played all the way to level 16 to see if it would ever get to the same point as the add, but nope. Never happened. A real shame.

false advertising- the ads you've seen are nothing like the actual gameplay. not a tower defence game...its just another township building game. UPDATE...after a couple of weeks playing...its actually dull,repetitive and slow progress. Dont bother with it..and ignore the standard reply they are giving to other reviews because thats also false information. It wouldn't 'sell' if they used actual gameplay to advertise, hence the fake advert.

I wanted the ad. This game is not the ad. I don't want an online clan city builder, I want the tower-defence, isometric resource runner you are advertising. (do not give me that 'tiny portion' reply. Just because 1%of the gameplay is ALMOST the ad, does not make it accurate. It is misleading and misrepresentation of your game.

I thought there would be a lot more game play like the great advertised game. Downloaded its nowhere neat as good which I find daft to make an advertised game let down by the actual game which all your doing is upgrading buildings with minimal fighting and restricted not allowing the king to charge anywhere like advertised and no coins spent to multiply his soldier residence. I don't get the programmers spending all that time on the advertised one.

It's okay. The reviews mentioning grinding upgrades, trawling through endless screens claiming rubbish prizes are 100% accurate. The art style is pretty good but mainly it's constant confusing screens that are never explained properly. I'm guessing that's intentional so you accidentally pick something that costs you. The real issue is the ad that brought us all here. It's absolutely false advertising. You will not be playing that game. That alone makes the publishers untrustworthy.

Another ad saying this game is what it says it is! No pay-to-win! Another load of b.s. Just a base-building and wait game (oh, but you can make the wait go faster...for money.) Not a tower defence shooter, it has about 30 secs of something kinda like that gameplay, not even similar to advert either. (You can get to do this bland, auto-aim snooze more.....for money.) If you want to compete then guess what, you can easily....for money. Better ways to waste time, avoid this game. devs lying scum

As others have said it's nothing like the adverts but it's still quite a fun game to try and progress through. I also spent no money and it didn't feel horrifically slow so good points. However, it constantly tries to force you into an alliance with random people and those alliances can attack you and wipe you out. Had this happen to me and I just want to play it solo without being forced into joining groups just to save what I have built. Very poor on that front.

Not the same game as in the ads. If you don't want to show your game in an ad, then make a game that you do. Waiting for you to claim the ads only show a tiny portion of the game, and that we should spend many hours playing the game to see all the unbelievable free content. If it was good enough, you'd advertise the actual game that people will see on launch.

Another infinite time-waster with false advertising (yes, there is no tower defense game there). Typical "build -upgrade-participate in alliance event" game with tons of simple mechanics and not a lot of depth. Hugely addictive, social pressure to pay real money is high and, of course, it is "pay to win" mostly. To be fair, it is really well made and there are, in fact, no ads. UPD their response to my comment is so silly that I am charging it from 2 to 1 star.

This is NOTHING LIKE THAT ADVERT. You will be forever chasing the next go faster pack. Updates often take days and then a week or two heading into three weeks without top up packs which I have seen some at £299.99p Generally from around £5.00 and all points going into hundreds of pounds!? Get these packs which you will require scores if not hundreds of to figure. Do yourself a favour and move on, this is just another hole in the internet for our money.

Game bears no resemblance to the advert. As you progress time taken for upgrades increases exponential, 3 real time days to upgrade town centre building alone from level 18 to 19. Basically it's a game for wannabe Bullies, so, gave up, it felt like wading through ever deepening Tar, and facing massive alliances who crush other players, Very awkward to close your account as well!!

stopped playing after 1 month-ish due to slow progress once you get to a high enough level, speedups are necessary to progress anything, and stronger teams will poach good members in lower level teams without hesitation. It's not an enjoyable game for casual gamers. You'll either get kicked out of a team if you leave it for a day, or good teammates will be poached edit: devs completely missed my point lmao

There is no moderation to chat conversations, and harrasment is incitivated by some of the "Alliances" in the game. The approach is simple, with the excuse that doing something is in benefit of the "Alliance" a player is forced to obey, there is a explicit dictatorial system on the game play, the strongest will always win. The defensive approach of the game is 100% not free. I have played this game for over 2 months, and it's disappointing. The game doesn't allow to escape from bullies.

I found the game to be fun initially and enjoyed levelling up. The game has many mechanics but very little is explained. My conclusion after 3 months of play is that as an intermediate player I'm mainly there as a punch bag for the established whale players, who use me as means of leveling-up. I woke this morning to find I'd been attacked 11x by the leader of my kingdom and that >50% of my hard-won troops had been killed. Sure I can regain my progression but this will take ages unless I spend $.

I don't really know where to start from? This game supposed to be fun and socially spending time platform and it's however if you have any issues with the game technically mistakes, and you do not get even one small item which is when you made purchases and don't received. DON'T MAKE a COMPLAINT ABOUT IT!!! If you do, you will only get ignored by AI automatic emailing or chat!!! Awful customer service and ignore this game!!!

I saw the ads... got annoyed by the ads.tried the game. I uninstalled pretty quickly as it was boring, a waste of my time. honestly if you're going to bombard my phone with terrible ads the least of want for the game itself is to keep me entertained longer than it took to download. and worse I'm now getting twice as many ads for a game I have already tried and don't want to do so ever again. I hope your creator stubs their toe on every corner.

So...that fun game you've seen in the ads? The one where you're picking up coins and building crossbow towers on the fly? Not this game. Here, you're gonna spend most of your time building a village, painstakingly upgrading ovens, tables and bunk beds, in preparation for slow-paced combat that rolls around occasionally. Seems like a fun game, cute artstyle, but definitely NOTHING like the ads.

I'm so tired of MISLEADING ADS and the game being very different to the ads. Just advertise the actual gameplay or make the game like the ad. Download just to get disappointed and delete after 5 minutes. This developer seems to keep doing this so I won't be downloading any of their games now. I am also tired of seeing the same exact pathetic copy paste IRRELEVANT response from the game dev LYING about "the ads show a tiny portion" NO THEY DON'T SHOW THE GAMEPLAY. False ad.

it's a good game, but it's not ad advertised. Once you've built your kingdom that's it, there's nothing else to do. you're forced to interact with other players and join alliances. It takes ages to level up the town, you run out of resources so quick it's unreal. It's so difficult to level up your hero's. This game had so much potential and it got wasted. I wouldn't bother downloading it.

This game is INCREDIBLY pay to win. First of all, it's nothing like the Asda it's not a tower defense game like I was advertised but instead a town upgrade sort of game however to upgrade everything takes time to do and I'm talking multiple hours waiting for something to upgrade. I bet your thinking, oh that's fine ill do it before bed but instead you can only upgrade 2 things at a time and you need to upgrade to progress in all the game including the mini game. just a lie and pay to win

Nothing like the adverts with the tedious influencers bros. Those show you galloping about building things to fight each level with coins from dropped enemies. In reality, it's boring building villages and collecting and upgrading heroes with no battle strategy because 99% of your time is spent clicking upgrade. Have played it for 15 minutes, bored to tears. Insta delete.

The advert that you watch and play is literally NOTHING like the actual game. Spend more time thumb bashing to build, upgrade, rush time and repeat. Eventually your town gets attacked and have to defend but it's very boring gameplay. This game just throws constant pointless garbage at you until you eventually hit a wall where you need to spend money to progress further into doing the exact same thing that you did before. build, upgrade, rush, repeat.

It's not so bad overall but don't waste your money. There's loads of META wanna be's playing the game who make multiple fake accounts to exploit for free resources. So unless you do the same, or are willing to spend unreasonable amounts of money on boosts, you will constantly fall behind and struggle to keep up with such players and compete. It kinda ruins the game and makes it feel pointless to play. There also seems to be very little control of this issue from the games admin team.

To everyone who spent money on the game read this: 1) Huge decrease in rewards from the moment you spend any money on the game called Pay to play and there is kingdom free to play (not spending money) 2) VIP disappears the moment you stop paying or sending money after 7/10 days (forgot) which gives you little rewards barely enough specially when you spent above £100 like me &500 I have 2 Kingdoms and compared them by spending more time on Pay to play Kingdom to improve it and it is a SCAMMMM

Very misleading game ads and game description. Every ad I saw that lead me to this game suggested it was a tower defence game (even the game page says such) but it actually a strategy game (similar to zombie survival), with a world map and other towns (Real players) all around you that you can attack or team up with and a tower defence MINI GAME every few levels. Not my favourite game genre at all. Ridiculous they resort to straight up lies to get people to play their game.

This is just another multiplayer strategy where your success hinges entirely on your alliance. Downloaded it as it seemed more single player focused than usual but this isnt the case, it's just another reskin of the same game, but it does have charm and is fun to play. My armies and city were entirely decimated within 2 hrs after attacks from 6+ other users and I lost interest in changing alliance again and grinding back up. If you're not a competitive player then don't bother.
